content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Street sweepers, vacuum trucks and farm mowers for municipalities; not asphalt, aggregate or mining equipment, despite shared road customers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Aerospace components, valves and pumps for aerospace and process plants; no overlap with road and quarry equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Primarily farm machinery with some construction and forestry equipment; main products differ from asphalt and aggregate plants."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Utility smart meters, power test equipment and filters; different products and customers from road and quarry equipment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors; not a manufacturer of road or quarry equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors for process and transport markets; different products from Astec's machines."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Industrial engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers; no overlap with asphalt, aggregate or mining machines."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids and lubricants; a consumables business unlike Astec's heavy equipment."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments for buildings and transit; different products and customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges and metal castings sold to equipment makers; a hardware component business, not road or quarry machinery."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Bearings and power transmission components sold to vehicle and machinery makers; component supplier, not equipment maker."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Mainly turf, lawn and irrigation equipment for landscapers; its Ditch Witch underground line overlaps Astec's drills but is a minor part."}]}
